title: [bug] Modules hardcode opaque tokens that are derivable from public SPA catalogs
description: Root cause: when a saveAs cc field uses opaque 43-char tokens (e.g. amazon-mq.md rabbitmqInstanceTypeClustered, bedrock.md modelSelectionIRstan/etc.), the modules currently require a per-configuration HAR to learn the token. WRONG — the SPA fetches public per-service catalogs at calculator.aws/pricing/2.0/meteredUnitMaps/<service>/USD/current/<service>.json that contain the full RegionlessRateCode mapping. Confirmed: mq.json (716KB) has 23 friendly-keyed entries covering ALL ActiveMQ + RabbitMQ instance/mode combos including RabbitMQ Single Instance (which amazon-mq.md currently marks Unknown). bedrock.json (2MB) and bedrockfoundationmodels.json (1.1MB) almost certainly carry Bedrock's 4 token fields too. Fix: (1) add scripts/resolve_token.py helper that fetches a catalog and returns RegionlessRateCode by friendly key, (2) rewrite amazon-mq.md to embed the full 23-entry token table inline and remove the per-instance-HAR caveat, (3) restore RabbitMQ Single Instance from Unknown→Inferred, (4) update bedrock.md to point at its catalogs, (5) add a general note to body-schema.md (or new references/opaque-tokens.md) on the catalog-resolution pattern.
close_reason: Root cause was correct: opaque tokens come from public catalogs at calculator.aws/pricing/2.0/meteredUnitMaps/<service>/USD/current/<service>.json (gzip-served). RegionlessRateCode IS the cc token. For MQ: shipped (1) scripts/resolve_token.py helper with cache (~/.cache/aws-calc/), (2) rewritten amazon-mq.md with full 23-entry friendly→token table embedded inline + how-to-resolve docs, restored Path 4 (RabbitMQ Single Instance) from Unknown to Inferred (token table exists, cc shape speculative), (3) references/opaque-tokens.md general pattern doc, (4) SKILL.md mentions the new script + reference. Captured rate $8167.30 reconciles via catalog: 10 × 730 × $0.963 (mq.json eu-west-1 RabbitMQ Active Standby m5.large) + storage + DT. Bedrock catalogs have the same shape but no friendly keys — followup aws-calc-rqj tracks the bedrock-specific model→token chain.
